display_long_description:
Extincteur AR is an augmented reality fire training simulator that brings learning directly into the trainee’s real environment. By combining real fire safety equipment such as extinguishers and hose reels (RIA) with digital scenarios, it allows participants to practice the right actions in realistic and secure conditions.

The application offers two complementary training modes. In free scenarios, the trainer can place fires and equipment anywhere to recreate situations tailored to the site. In scripted scenarios, specific prevention themes such as overloaded power strips, blocked exits, or missing safety signs are integrated to raise awareness of good practices.

Each session lasts about five to six minutes, a short and effective format that keeps attention high. The trainer controls the experience through an intuitive interface and can analyze the trainee’s reactions in real time.

With Extincteur AR, fire safety training becomes immersive, interactive, and eco-friendly, with no risks, no consumables, and no logistical constraints. This simulator is designed for companies, training centers, and independent instructors who want to modernize their programs and strengthen safety culture within their teams.
